notes:
The installation overlay shows RecCheck's own icon now, not the letter A — that was the Caps Lock glyph, reused by mistake.

The button that fetched the in-house list is gone. It was the experiment that proved the read worked; the helper now takes every list the moment protel opens it, so there is nothing left to press. The line beside it stays and says what was captured.

And when a capture is refused it says which reason, instead of one vague message for all of them.
